title: Hunts FH-025: Register events and measurement model

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 2, Attribution. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Add reason classes, medium, cohort and assurance with PII allowlist and opt-in controls. Done when: Guest analytics forwarding stays off by default and logs omit exact locations, codes and contact details. Requires: FH-010, FH-023. Owner role: Analytics.
